changelog:
- Initial release of the tax-deduction-finder skill.
- Scans user transactions to identify potentially missed tax deductions for freelancers and small businesses.
- Highlights common deduction categories such as home office, technology, travel, professional development, insurance, finance, and marketing expenses.
- Suggests correct tax categorization (SKR04) and explains deduction eligibility.
- Estimates potential additional deductions and tax savings.
- Guides re-categorization of transactions with user confirmation and provides compliance tips.
